Use "Update" to fix/re-enter Status or Dates on tasks that already exist — much faster than editing one by one.

Click to select Excel file
.xlsx or .xls files supported

📋 Required Excel Format

Your Excel file must have these column headers in Row 1:

ColumnHeader NameExample
ATask NameWall Breaking
BOwnerRishi Khanna
CStatusOpen / Closed / In Progress
DStart Date01-Feb-2026
EDue Date05-Feb-2026
FCompletion Date05-Feb-2026
GPhasePhase I (optional)
HRemarksNotes (optional)
💡 Google Sheets Tip
After importing, use Export to Excel button in any project to get a full .xlsx with all tasks — then upload directly to Google Sheets for real-time collaboration.

📤 Export to Google Sheets (Excel format — project-wise sheets)

Export all project data as a single Excel file with one sheet per project. Open in Google Sheets by uploading to Drive.

How to sync with Google Sheets:
1. Click "Export ALL Projects" → downloads DKD_Projects.xlsx
2. Open Google Drive → New → File Upload → select the file
3. Right-click the uploaded file → "Open with Google Sheets"
4. Each project will be a separate tab/sheet automatically ✅

☁️ Google Drive Sync

Photos & videos from Site Report updates back up automatically to Google Drive

Connection Status

⚪ Not connected (saving locally only)
Connect the teamchatgptt@gmail.com Google account here once. After that, every photo and video added in Site Report Portal uploads automatically to a "DKD Site Reports" folder in that account's Drive, organised by project. This same connection also lets "Email Report to Client" send updates directly from teamchatgptt@gmail.com. If not connected, media is kept on this device only and reports can't be emailed.

🔑 Client Login Sync

⚪ Not connected — client logins only work on the device that created them
This makes client logins (like client-raheja) work on any device — the client's phone, laptop, anywhere — not just the device that created them. Without this, a client login only works on the exact browser where you set it up. Paste the Database URL from your Firebase project once; nothing else changes about how you add clients (still just Edit Project → Client Email + Password, same as before).

💾 Data Backup

Download a backup file of everything saved on this device (all projects, tasks, and site updates). Keep it somewhere safe — you can restore it on any device later if needed.
